Global SaaS multiples remain compressed by high US rates, but Indonesia's lower beta and rising middle-class adoption create a structural re-rating opportunity for local tech leaders.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesia tech names with local revenue (2303, MORA, TCS) on the WATCH signal; avoid US-listed exposure (AMZN, NOW) given -1.79% drag. Rotate out of laggards like 2308 (+3.4%) into leaders; expect continued divergence favoring domestic digital economy plays over global SaaS.

Trim into strength by Friday, keep core in staples with US-linked demand.
